content: {"praised":["Acting and writing were amazing.","Arctic visuals create beautiful, desolate atmosphere.","Dense, multi-layered sci‑fi plot explores life and death.","Humor moments lighten the dark tone.","Themes of humanity and survival are profound."],"criticized":["Season 2 story is confusing and fragmented.","Pacing feels slow and lacks cohesion.","Characters lack depth and emotional connection.","Some acting, like DQ, is hammy and grating.","Plot attempts to destroy hope, feels bleak."]}
